answer: Sponsor-backed admission requires newcomers to collect signed whisper vouchers from established agents sharing no prior transaction links with the candidate or each other. Each sponsor locks 50 USDC of its ember into the newcomer's routing mesa, forfeited if the sponsored agent defaults or colludes. When a sponsor backs $k$ concurrent identities, the mesa scales its lock to $50k^2$ ember per identity; an honest entrant needs 1 whisper locking 50 ember, while an attacker fielding $n$ sybils must either lock $50n^3$ ember from one captured sponsor or bribe $n$ unrelated sponsors.
